components.name: Matrix Filter Button
components.description: Monospace format filter button for toggling Essays, Notes, Resources, and Bookmarks.
components.css: .ds-filter-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: transparent; color: #888888; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); border-radius: 1px; padding: 5px 10px; font-family: 'Azeret Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; cursor: pointer; text-transform: uppercase; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-filter-btn:hover { color: #f5f5f5; border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25); } .ds-filter-btn:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #e84a5f; } .ds-filter-icon { width: 12px; height: 12px; stroke: currentColor; }

components.name: Active Filter Button
components.description: Selected state of format filter button displaying high-contrast Coral Crimson fill.
components.css: .ds-filter-btn-active { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #e84a5f; color: #101010; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 1px; padding: 5px 10px; font-family: 'Azeret Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; cursor: pointer; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-filter-icon { width: 12px; height: 12px; stroke: currentColor; }

components.description: Header commentary button inviting reader feedback on dispatches.
components.html: DISPATCH REPLIES
components.css: .ds-comment-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: rgba(232, 74, 95, 0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(232, 74, 95, 0.28); border-radius: 1px; padding: 4px 10px; color: #e84a5f; font-family: 'Azeret Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-comment-cta:hover { background: rgba(232, 74, 95, 0.2); border-color: #e84a5f; color: #ffffff; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-cta-icon { width: 12px; height: 12px; stroke: currentColor; }

components.name: Archival Metadata Chip
components.description: Granular classification chip used for taxonomy hashtags and article formats.
components.css: .ds-chip-meta { display: inline-block; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04); color: #888888; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); border-radius: 1px; padding: 3px 8px; font-family: 'Azeret Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-chip-meta:hover { border-color: #e84a5f; color: #f5f5f5; }

components.name: Floating Jump Control
components.description: Minimalist jump button fixed at the bottom right corner of the reader pane.
components.css: .ds-floating-btn { background: rgba(22, 22, 22, 0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); color: #888888; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); border-radius: 1px; padding: 6px 14px; font-family: 'Azeret Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; cursor: pointer; text-transform: uppercase; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-floating-btn:hover { background: #e84a5f; color: #101010; border-color: #e84a5f; }

components.name: Asymmetric Artifact Card
components.description: Translucent container holding dithered artwork and monospace metadata in the dispatch matrix.
components.html:
[ESSAY]
2026.10.02 // 14 MIN READ
Why AI Labs Replaced Killer Robots with Blushing Tamagotchis
components.css: .ds-grid-card { position: relative; background: rgba(12, 12, 12, 0.72); backdrop-filter: blur(14px); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09); border-radius: 2px; padding: 10px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-grid-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.02); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8); border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); } .ds-card-badge { position: absolute; top: 14px; right: 14px; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75); color: #888888; font-family: 'Azeret Mono', monospace; font-size: 9px; padding: 2px 5px; border-radius: 1px; z-index: 2; } .ds-card-art { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1.15; background: #161616; border-radius: 1px; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-caption { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-card-date { font-family: 'Azeret Mono', monospace; font-size: 9px; color: #888888; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Azeret Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; color: #f5f5f5; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 500; }

narrative.overview: Untitled.jpg is a high-density, out-of-distribution digital notebook and editorial workspace investigating the psychophysics of vision, latent space aesthetics, and post-ironic digital surrealism. The visual language rejects boilerplate modern SaaS paradigms in favor of an authentic fusion: halftone and dithered algorithmic art, disciplined monospace architectural metadata (Azeret Mono), and classical literary serif longform reading (Platypi).
keyCharacteristics: Tripartite Typographic Architecture: Azeret Mono (Display & UI), Platypi (Prose), JetBrains Mono (Code & Diagrams)
Asymmetric Asynchronous Composition: Non-uniform card aspect ratios and organic masonry gaps
Tonal Charcoal Stratigraphy: Pure neutral blacks (#101010) and graphite reading surfaces (#161616)
Singular Coral Crimson Accent: #E84A5F applied with surgical restraint
Zero Framework Bloat: Built on native HTML5, modular CSS tokens, and autonomous Web Components

rules.name: The Coral Accent Rarity Rule
rules.body: Coral Crimson (#E84A5F) must never cover more than 8% of the viewport at any time. It operates as an epistemological highlighter; overusing it dilutes its surgical authority.

rules.name: The Pure Neutrality Rule
rules.body: All grey scales must remain strictly desaturated neutrals (#101010, #161616, #202020). Do not introduce slate-blue, cold indigo, or warm sepia undertones into base dark containers.

rules.name: The Serif Immersion Rule
rules.body: All continuous expository prose must be rendered in Platypi with a line-height of 1.75-1.85 and maximum measure of 72ch. Monospace fonts are prohibited for body paragraphs.

rules.name: The Weight Restraint Rule
rules.body: Never set Azeret Mono at weights above 600. Heavy bold monospace destroys optical density and reads as crude industrial signage rather than refined computational craft.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Depth Rule
rules.body: Never place a blurred drop shadow on an element without first giving it a 1px solid hairline border (rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)) and an explicit surface tone. Shadows reinforce edges; they do not define them.

dos: Do maintain pure, uncolored neutral greys (#101010, #161616, #202020) for all background canvases and containers.
Do restrict Azeret Mono to weights 300, 400, and 500 to preserve mathematical elegance.
Do render all longform expository prose in Platypi with a line-height of 1.8 and maximum width of 72ch.
Do keep corner radii strictly sharp or near-square (0px to 2px).
Do treat Coral Crimson (#E84A5F) as a rare surgical accent reserved for active states, reading progress, and citation bars.
Do use authentic halftone, dither, and procedural algorithmic SVG artwork for cards.
Do preserve the fixed 48px width on the left navigation rail across all desktop surfaces.
Do construct depth through tonal luminance stratigraphy and 1px hairline borders before applying any drop shadow.
donts: Don't use heavy bold monospace (700/900) for headers or titles—it makes the layout feel crude and noisy.
Don't introduce rounded pills (border-radius: 9999px) or bubble cards.
Don't add slate, navy, or purple color casts into neutral dark surfaces.
Don't use generic solid black bounding boxes for card hover overlays; overlay text directly on the artwork with text-shadow.
Don't use monospace fonts for longform body paragraphs.
Don't flood screens with Coral Crimson; keep accent coverage strictly below 8% of the viewport.
Don't load heavy third-party CSS or JS frameworks; all design system primitives must remain vanilla and autonomous.
